label: Equipment maintenance
action: Service and repair diagnostic equipment within the technician’s area of competence.
notes: The selected technical contribution complements routine checks by laboratory staff; responsibilities depend on the equipment and setting.

label: Quality assurance
action: Plan improvements and review the laboratory’s quality records.

label: Blood sample collection
action: Collect and label blood for the requested laboratory testing.
notes: Blood is the collection example here; other tests use other specimen types and collection roles.

label: Specimen preparation
action: Prepare received patient specimens for examination.

label: Laboratory analysis
action: Examine samples using laboratory instruments and record the findings.
notes: Microscopy and cell counting are examples; a test does not necessarily use both.

label: Result recording
action: Record test findings in the patient’s medical record.
notes: WHO describes authorization and reporting as post-analytical work; local responsibilities and review arrangements vary.

label: Clinical interpretation
action: Interpret test findings with the patient’s history and examination.
